body: From the DM-172 review (orchestrator): the timing fixtures in src/core/space/fixtures/timing/ and scratch/DM-172/*.ts become tests here. Also pin these boundaries: (1) a span starting at the exact instant a pause begins is not cut (`pause.start > start.ms`); (2) a span starting inside a pause runs to the first observation after resume; (3) after an adoption that renames the active sprint, the time a ticket waited under the old sprint id lands in no window; (4) coverage reads 1 on some missing measures (#18). Also note that scratch/DM-170/c1-migration.ts hard-codes schema v10: target SCHEMA_VERSION.
